strongest_allowed_claim: Within the declared W3C PROV-DM generation profile, the PROV representation is an exact strict projection of complete generation facts.
supported_only_if: PROV-N equals qualified PROV-O after independent normalization
at least two valid distinct Snapshots have identical profile projections
prohibited_interpretations: W3C PROV is incomplete, wrong, non-general, or non-extensible
Core replaces or dominates W3C PROV
all possible PROV extensions fail to represent complete generation facts
a result for this fixture automatically generalizes to every domain
not_evaluated: PROV components and serializations excluded by the profile
domains outside the deterministic fixture family
